stem.text: A cable on a suspension bridge supports a weight of $19.3 \times 10^{5}\,\text{N}$. This weight causes the cable to stretch by $47\,\text{mm}$.
A lorry crossing the bridge then increases the force on the cable to $23.3 \times 10^{5}\,\text{N}$. The force-extension graph for the cable is shown.

stem.alt: Force/N against extension/mm graph: a straight line from the origin, with dashed guide lines at force 19.3 × 10^5 N and 23.3 × 10^5 N, and extensions 47 mm and 57 mm marked on the horizontal axis.

stem.text: What is the **increase** in strain energy in the cable when the lorry is crossing the bridge?
